name: qa-web-e2e
description: Web E2E testing with Playwright, Cypress, Selenium and WebdriverIO, plus cloud grids, a self-hosted Selenium Grid 4, and cross-browser test matrices. Covers BrowserStack, Sauce Labs and LambdaTest, traffic-based T1/T2/T3 browser tiers, and a framework decision guide. Agents (playwright-codegen-reviewer, automation-harness-bootstrapper) refactor recorded Playwright or Cypress Studio specs and scaffold a full E2E harness for a repo with no suite.
